input.subject: KPC-2026-014: Clarifications needed on RM-008, RM-009 and outstanding documents
input.body:
Dear Jasper,

Thank you for your reply, the rate card, and the COA for Copper Tripeptide-1.

We need the following to continue the evaluation. Please reply by 8 November 2026.

Open technical points:
1. RM-008 Rosemary leaf extract: your quote is based on carnosic acid. Our specification is 20% rosmarinic acid. Please confirm the rosmarinic acid content of the material offered and state the quantity needed to deliver the same rosmarinic acid content as our spec.
2. RM-009 Copper Tripeptide-1 solution: the COA shows 812 ppm peptide, while the quote states 1,000 ppm. Please confirm the peptide concentration of the batch you will supply, explain the difference, and confirm whether the price and quantity need to change to meet our 1,000 ppm specification.

Required documents and information:
3. Certificate of Analysis for each line (RM-001 to RM-010), showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date. The COA we have covers only RM-009.
4. Current Safety Data Sheet for each line, including transport hazard class. You mentioned these will follow; please send them with your reply.
5. Confirmation that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp cosmetic use and permitted under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.
6. Name and country of the manufacturer for each line, since you are quoting as a trader.
7. Legal entity name, registered address, GSTIN (or overseas tax ID) of the entity that will invoice us, and the site that will supply us.
8. Your ISO 9001 certificate and any GMP certificate held by the manufacturer, with expiry dates.
9. Whether any key input is single-sourced, with its country of origin and any alternate source.
10. Your earliest date for first delivery, against our need-by date of 20 December 2026.

Please also confirm which of the ten lines you are quoting.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
